title: [uuencoding] Validate length byte range in decode_line
description: Skoll MEDIUM-39: decode_line computes length with (first.wrapping_sub(32)) & 0x3F without checking that the first byte is in the valid UU range (0x20-0x60). Bytes 0x61-0xFF are silently masked to 6-bit values. Add a range check: valid non-terminator length bytes are 0x21..=0x5F, return InvalidChar for bytes outside this range.
close_reason: Added range check on UU length byte: reject bytes outside 0x21..=0x5F with InvalidChar error at col 0. Added tests for high and low invalid length bytes.
